descriptions.pick_and_place: ALWAYS load for plain single-object tasks: "put a/some X in/on Y", "place X on Y", "move X to Y" (e.g. "put a mug on the desk", "put some soap in the cabinet", "put a book on the bed", "put a pencil in the drawer"). Use whenever the task has no clean/hot/cool/lamp words and no "two". Find, take, put. Default for simple put tasks.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "two", "2", "both", or a plural object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa", "put two cds in the drawer", "find two soapbars and put them in the cabinet"). Take one, place it, then find and place a second different one.
descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: ALWAYS load for ANY task with look at / examine / inspect / see an object under, with, or in a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp", "examine the book with the desklamp"). Not a put task: take the object, go to the lamp, `use` it to turn it on.
